Legal notes

No medical advice

Aura helps you keep track of your nutrition and training. The calculated calorie and nutrient goals are estimates and do not replace advice from a doctor or nutrition professional. If you have health questions or pre-existing conditions, are pregnant or have an eating disorder, please consult a professional.

Liability for content

The content of this app was created with the greatest care. However, we cannot guarantee that the content is correct, complete and up to date, in particular nutrition information from external databases.

Liability for links

The app contains links to external third-party websites whose content we have no influence on. The respective provider is always responsible for the content of linked pages. If we become aware of any infringements, we will remove such links immediately.
